findings.title: Freeze the complete structural capacity profile in CONTRACT-013
findings.body: The normative surface specifies byte limits and selected native array limits, but does not state the accepted-request modules1..256 limit or the shared strict decoder capacities applied to all four objects and each nested documentJson. The implementation therefore refuses otherwise-valid, matching-hash unknown source content well below the documented byte ceiling for unstated reasons. This is a normative capacity-profile gap, not an authority or semantic-admission bug.
